label: DrayTek Vigor166 G.fast / VDSL2 35b modem
description: G.fast (106 MHz, up to 1.3 Gbit/s sync rate) DSL-to-Ethernet bridge that falls back to VDSL2 35b supervectoring at 300 Mbit/s and ADSL2+ at 20 Mbit/s, with one RJ-11 line port and two gigabit LAN ports; also runs as a mini router with NAT/DMZ host.
notes: Datasheet: 'Max G.fast Sync Rate: 1.3Gb/s', 'Max VDSL2 35b Sync Rate: 300Mb/s', 'Max VDSL2 17a Sync Rate: 100Mb/s', 'Max ADSL2+ Sync Rate: 20Mb/s'; Physical Interfaces 2 x Gigabit Ethernet + WAN1 G.Fast/VDSL RJ-11. Line side declared 300M = VDSL2 35b rung of the engine's DSL ladder; the 1.3 Gbit/s G.fast figure is a sync rate no 300M/1G port step represents, so it stays in the description.
